description: Asks CANOPY's sales team to arrange a tour at a location, for times that suit the person: for locations booked by request, locations not yet open, or when no listed time works. Step 1, without confirm_token: returns a preview and a confirm_token (valid 10 minutes); nothing is saved. Step 2, with the same details and the confirm_token: sends the request. A CANOPY sales manager follows up within one business day. Only call step 2 after the person agrees.
name: request_tour
title: Ask for a CANOPY tour (two steps)
